title: Vatra Cloud
intro: Reach this hub from anywhere and get notifications through the Vatra relays, without opening a port on your router.
beta: Beta: remote access only works once this hub id is on the Vatra Cloud allow-list. Send the hub id to the Vatra team to join.

remote.label: Remote access
remote.hint: Open this hub at its public address from outside your home. Traffic stays end-to-end encrypted to this hub.

push.label: Push relay
push.hint: Send phone notifications through the Vatra push relay instead of a Firebase or Apple key of your own.

state.label: Tunnel
state.clients: {count, plural, =0 {no open connections} one {# open connection} other {# open connections}}

cert.title: Certificate
cert.none: No certificate yet. It is issued automatically when remote access is turned on.

privacy.title: What the Vatra relays see
privacy.body: The remote access relay only forwards encrypted TLS: the certificate and its key live on this hub, so the relay cannot read your pages or data. The push relay sees device ids, the notification kind and timing; the notification content is encrypted for your phone.

errors.forbidden: Only the home owner can change Vatra Cloud.
errors.demo_readonly: Vatra Cloud cannot be changed on the demo hub.
errors.issue_failed: The certificate could not be issued. Check that this hub id is on the allow-list and try again later.
